_comment: Standing owner rule (2026-11-24): on EVERY workflow run, check when production last changed; if it has been more than max_days, promote the newest release candidate to production. The age is read LIVE from Google Play on every check (production track + the store listing's own 'Updated on' line) — never from state.json or any other cache. This is a recorded owner ask, not an agent inference: `team/autopromote.py` carries `requested_by` into the promotion record.
